rongmei.title: Maan guang the kandih ringhmei tingkao

lines: 1. Maan guang the kandi ringhmei tingkao gaimei ‘na the,
Ai kalanga zau bam e guang tangnimei ram tei;
Kandi zinghbang kumsini ‘tik kagun daihpui ram,
Na guang the Immanuel namdaih gaimei tei.
2. He! Jisu duikhun e Nang nzianmei duidai e,
Kandi khou rianramei hei Tingkao thu gai khang e;
Rianramei kandi khou hei lungni Nang paan khou rui,
Tik daihmei Immanuel Poubaomei pan rui.
3. Kauh latzan sumei Pu rui ‘zianloupui zaeng khou rui,
Rianrana kabmei nun khang tilouni tingkao ram;
Hou khang ning e Nangpaan rui tingkao gaipui ram tei,
Neih keidat makpui ram e zinghmei naidat mak.
4. Noupeih rui noupouhpu lun hounimei kum ai ni,
Houni e namdaih khang suang ‘zianmei Poubaomei lun;
Lanimei Guangh pirun suang ning thukge timei pu,
Akhang tikgun dailiangmei Lauziu Na tei e.
5. Tingkao Guangh nzianmei rui kandi ti-neihlalou,
Rianramei guanglou sini nzianmei ru ngam e;
Thuanku o Poubaomei ta thuaihian liangmei Pu ta,
Akhang tilou the Salem namthanh gaimei tei.
